findings.label: HIGH-3 concurrency proven sequentially
findings.detail: The two-partial over-capture test runs sequentially (second request 409) rather than truly concurrently. The acquireRefundLock advisory lock and the under-lock net-refundable recompute are present and correct, so the invariant Sum(refunds) <= capture is still proven; a concurrent test would exercise lock contention directly. No code change required.

findings.label: No-op ternary in collection net
findings.detail: buildCollectionReport computes netPaise as (net > 0n ? net : net).toString(), a harmless leftover where both branches return the same value. net can legitimately be negative and the emitted value is correct. Optionally simplify to net.toString().
